title: File:Daniel Craig, producer Barbara Broccoli, actress Naomie Harris and actor Christoph Waltz - Film Premiere "Spectre" 007 (22547549736).jpg
desc:
Actor Daniel Craig, producer Barbara Broccoli, actress Naomie Harris and actor Christoph Waltz attend the German premiere of the new James Bond movie 'Spectre' at CineStar on October 28, 2015 in Berlin, Germany.
